title: Learning Roles with Emergent Social Value Orientations
reasoning: The paper focuses on Social Value Orientations (SVO) such as altruism and prosociality within the context of 'social dilemmas' (e.g., the Prisoner's Dilemma). These dilemmas are foundational models used to evaluate ethical decision-making, cooperation, and moral behavior (balancing self-interest against the collective good) in multi-agent systems.
